purpose: DWP's Pathways to Work evidence pack, chapter 2 (the data tables' file of 23 July 2025), Tables 2.9 and 2.10: the PIP caseload's daily living points by band and mobility points by total, by age group, in England and Wales at the end of January 2025, normal rules, as shares of each group's claimants with the group's volume (microcosm#1095, P1 of the November event-data plan). Consumed by the pip_points stage, which draws each recipient's points within their stored award from their age group's distribution. No value is derived here.
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
